tickets.title: Follow up on account security concern
tickets.text:
Security concern type: unauthorized access
Affected account or platform: Velvet Acorn Custody
Date client reported concern: 2025-11-06
Client's preferred contact method: phone
Immediate action requested: reset credentials, notify custodian, monitor activity
Custodian or platform contact: Velvet Acorn Custody security department
Evidence to review: Paige Lanternmoss's forwarded login alert for unrecognized session, her statement that she could not verify recent account activity
Resolution status: open
Next client update: 2025-11-07 via phone
Internal notes: Follow-up agreed for custodian escalation, evidence documentation, credential reset coordination, and phone update to Paige by 2025-11-07.
tickets.evidence: They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-07 covering custodian escalation, evidence documentation, credential reset coordination, and a phone update to Paige.

tickets.title: Follow up on missing signature
tickets.text: Contact the signer through the approved communication channel to explain which document still needs signature, where to sign, and how to return it securely. Confirm receipt of the completed signature page and update the document status log. The missing signature is from Darin Lanternmoss on the household authorization package. Paige Lanternmoss has already signed her pages.
tickets.evidence: They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-10 to contact Darin through the approved channel, explain the required signature location, and confirm secure return of the signed page.

tickets.title: Track custodian transfer status
tickets.text: Check the pending transfer with the receiving custodian, note the latest status, and alert the advisor if assets, cost basis, or residual cash have not arrived as expected. The transfer involves securities moved from Teacup Comet Brokerage to Velvet Acorn Custody for the Lanternmoss household's joint taxable account; the cost basis file and a small residual cash sweep do not match the sending statement uploaded by Paige Lanternmoss.
tickets.evidence: They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-12 to check the receiving custodian’s latest status and document whether remaining assets or basis details are still pending.

tickets.title: Complete beneficiary update workflow
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client needs to add, remove, or revise beneficiary designations. Confirm the requested change, gather the required custodian forms or online instructions, submit the update, and verify the custodian's final confirmation before closing the loop with the client. Paige Lanternmoss requested changes to IRA beneficiary records at Velvet Acorn Custody, including revised primary and contingent percentages for Darin Lanternmoss, Liora Lanternmoss, and the Willow Pudding Family Trust.

subTasks.title: Confirm beneficiary instructions
subTasks.text: Review the client's requested beneficiary changes, including primary and contingent beneficiaries, percentages, relationship details, and any per stirpes or trust-related language. Flag anything that requires attorney or estate planning review.

subTasks.title: Prepare custodian documentation
subTasks.text: Identify the correct beneficiary update method for each affected account, prepare forms or portal steps, and confirm whether spousal consent, medallion signature guarantee, or trust documentation is required.

subTasks.title: Submit and track update
subTasks.text: Submit the completed documentation through the approved custodian channel and track the request until the custodian confirms the beneficiary record has been updated.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send the client a concise confirmation that the beneficiary update has been completed, noting any accounts still pending or any items the client should retain with estate documents.

tickets.evidence: They agreed on follow-up by 2025-11-21 covering the proposed asset, charity delivery instructions, tax coordination questions, and confirmation evidence needed for Paige’s records.
